answer: Each agent locks 70 credits and files a sealed hash of its lagoon survey, then wanders three lagoon stations. A random signal summons one in ten, who must reveal hash, key, and readings within an hour for audit. A late reveal burns 20, a second burns the bond, and a rented reveal hash burns every sharer. Filing costs 45 first, 6 more per extra identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked, against 40,000. An honest agent pays 45 once.
